question: After retaining a supported Step 3.5 default for Step Plan, should standard StepFun fresh setups move to Step 3.7 despite the provider’s mixed current recommendation pages?
rationale: The Step Plan repair is contract-driven, but the standard default cannot be inferred safely from inconsistent provider guidance or model availability alone.

options.title: Keep both on Step 3.5
options.body: Preserve current defaults until StepFun’s supported-model and recommendation documentation consistently selects Step 3.7.

options.title: Move standard only
options.body: Default only standard StepFun to Step 3.7 after authenticated proof and retain Step Plan on Step 3.5.

options.title: Approve shared Step 3.7
options.body: Use Step 3.7 for both products only with current provider confirmation and authenticated proof that supersedes the published Step Plan support list.

recommendation.title: Keep both on Step 3.5
recommendation.body: Preserve current defaults until StepFun’s supported-model and recommendation documentation consistently selects Step 3.7.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and substantially corrected the current Step 3.7 integration, making him the strongest available owner for its default-policy decision.
